'''Palhra Wavren''' was a civilian who was held hostage by [[Roshu Sune/Legends|Roshu Sune]] guerrillas when a [[Passenger liner/Legends|commuter hopper]] she was traveling on was [[Gotal hostage standoff|hijacked]] and set down in the swamps outside of [[Skreeka]], on [[Atzerri/Legends|Atzerri]], where the [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] guerrillas had a temporary base. Along with 12 other hostages out of 25, Wavren was rescued by a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] task force led by [[Sarrissa Jeng/Legends|Sarrissa Jeng]], although she was injured in the fight, probably by burns or smoke inhalation. Wavren was taken to [[Talos (spaceport)|Talos]] [[Talos Port Medicomplex|Port Medicomplex]] to recover.
